## Change

What changes for the player or teammate? Link the Issue with `Closes #NUMBER`.

## Validation

- Editor version / tested scene or build:
- Steps run and observed result:
- Screenshot or clip for visual changes:
- Known limitations or follow-up work:

For documentation-only changes, state that gameplay testing is not applicable.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope matches the linked Issue and acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Relevant assets and `.meta` files are included; binary assets follow LFS rules.
- [ ] Shared scene/Prefab ownership was coordinated (or no shared asset changed).
- [ ] New assets are recorded in the asset register (or none added).
- [ ] Package/editor/settings changes are explained (or none changed).
- [ ] Generated code/assets were reviewed and relevant behavior was tested.
